title: 1997 Greer briefing with Admiral Wilson

tellings.quote: 1997 was when the Greer Will Miller uh Thomas Wilson Steven Lovekin meeting took place.

plain: In 1997, in Washington DC, a man named Steven Greer is said to have held a briefing on UFO matters with a Navy admiral named Thomas R. Wilson, joined by two other men, Willard Miller and Stephen Lovekin. An online researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb mentions the meeting in passing, without naming a source. It matters to those who tell it because it would mean a senior military officer was directly approached about secret UFO knowledge.
